author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
We're back at @NationalParkService's Museum Conservation Lab, where textile conservator Anne Ennes takes Adam Savage through the careful unpacking of a trunk that once belonged to Bertha Cone, wife of "Denim King" Moses King, supplier to Levi Strauss & Co. at the turn of the 19th century. Here's how conservators separated, cleaned and flattened the many mystery bundles of textiles that bugs and mold had dined on for over a century in the North Carolina heat and humidity. Could you guess from the thumbnail what some of the mystery bundles are? 

We're doing a panel with current and former National Park Service museum conservators at Awesome Con on Sunday, March 15!!! Join us and come with questions: 
https://awesome-con.com/programming/#/event/adam-savage-behind-the-scenes-with-national-park-services-art-conservators

National Park Museum Conservation Lab: https://www.nps.gov/subjects/hfc/museum-conservation-services.htm
Visit Moses H. Cone Memorial Park: https://www.nps.gov/blri/plany
